title: Money Calculator
technologies: Next.js, TypeScript, Supabase, PostgreSQL, Vitest, Playwright
description: In-progress personal-finance application built around ledger-backed records. Includes transaction correction/reversal history, account balances, lending and borrowing lifecycle, tuition payments, asset tracking, budgeting, reporting, and financial forecasts. Repository includes unit and database-integration testing for key financial invariants.

title: Durga-Map
description: Android-focused Durga Puja location explorer that extracts GPS coordinates from photos, organizes location records, and helps users open mapped locations in Google Maps. Includes photo-metadata handling and an Android app workflow.

title: ASTA Store
description: E-commerce storefront for handmade leather bags with product browsing, cart management, checkout flow, Supabase authentication, and an administrative product-management area.

title: Mount Royal Academy Website
description: School website project with admissions/application flow, academic calendar, notices, gallery management, and authenticated content administration.

title: 999 National Emergency Service
description: Academic desktop application concept for citizen registration, emergency-service request entry with time/location details, and administrative request monitoring. Not a live emergency dispatch service.

title: Blockchain Internet of Things (bIoT) Thesis
description: Undergraduate literature review and proposed architecture exploring blockchain-based security for healthcare IoT, including authentication, data integrity, remote patient monitoring, and medical-data privacy.

title: Student Performance Dashboard
description: Dashboard concept for presenting student results, attendance, and classroom-performance indicators using illustrative sample data; not connected to a live school database.

title: Digital Coaching Spreadsheet Automation
description: Small workflow automation that adds a missing current-date column to an Attendance sheet and a missing current-month column to a Payment sheet, avoiding duplicate headers.
